metadata.title: That 1 luckshot where I swear Valorant paused to help me out
metadata.description:
Wait, did the enemy forget to shoot back? 
How did that even connect? No clue, but I’m not complaining.
Click if your best kills come from pure chaos!

Hit play if your aim sometimes just decides to show up!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
